title: The attach card in a WhatsApp chat is no longer hidden
text: In the WhatsApp tab, pressing the paperclip opened the Scan document / Photo or file card underneath the message area, so it could not be clicked. The emoji picker had the same problem. Both now open fully on top of the chat.
stepsTitle: Attaching a file in a WhatsApp chat

steps.name: Open a WhatsApp chat
steps.detail: Any chat in the WhatsApp tab.

steps.name: Press the paperclip
steps.detail: The card opens above the message bar.

steps.name: Pick Photo or file
steps.detail: Choose what to send, then confirm.
